caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate teapot rendered in shades of black, grey, and white, characteristic of pencil or ink illustration on an off-white background. The teapot has a hexagonal body with a domed, faceted lid topped by a pointed finial, a large curved handle on the left, and an elongated, upward-curving spout on the right. The surface of the teapot is intricately decorated with dense floral patterns and foliage motifs, especially prominent on the main body and extending partially onto the lid. There is a central inscription on the front panel of the teapot reading “Presented by A. A. Marsh.” and a monogram above it. The drawing is signed in the lower right corner with the name "L. DROZDOFF." The composition centers the teapot, and the background is plain and unadorned except for some gradual discoloration or age marks near the edges.
title: Silver Chocolate Pot
